assertion_analysis.fails_if: Either production caller stops feeding the pointer to the shared projection helper, so the snapshot and derived obligation differ; this parity assertion supplements the independent expected-behavior assertions below.
Restore the original unconditional stored-refusal remedy: the answered row becomes queued-awaiting-session instead of run-queued, as the final-test negative control demonstrates.
Remove the hold-reading block or discard its reason when applying placements: the output loses the independently specified held-for-allowance prefix or the input reason.
Restore the generic lane-slot next_command overwrite: the stored allowance reason is absent from the output command.
Retain or leak the old --answer wiring-1 command anywhere in the answered row.
Suppress the remedy for an unanswered finding as well as an answered finding: the row ceases to be queued-awaiting-session.
Drop or replace the unresolved remedy instead of preserving the command independently generated by plan_review.answer_invocation.

assertion_independence: No self-fulfilling assertion found: the fixture hold reason is an input checked for propagation through production output, not a return value passed back into its own expectation; command expectation comes from the established plan-review command owner; parity alone cannot prove behavior, which the independent literal kind/verdict and command-presence assertions supply.
